data.name: Coyaba Beach Resort
data.description:
Set on a tranquil stretch of white sand beach along the Caribbean coast, this relaxed resort surrounded by tropical gardens is 6 km from Fort George and 7 km from Grenada National Museum.
Featuring wood furnishings and colorful accents, the casual rooms provide sitting areas, minifridges and cable TV, and tea and coffeemakers, as well as balconies or patios. Upgraded rooms have sea views. Room service is offered.
There are 2 restaurants and 3 bars, including a swim-up bar at the outdoor pool. A gym, a spa and a tennis court are available, and there's also an on-site dive center.
